column2: A long wooden bridge spans the river and links the two towns.
column3: 一座長長的木橋橫跨河面，連接兩個城鎮。
column5: span 像手掌張開的一拃，一拃一拃橫跨過去

column2: My cousin wants to specialize in children's medicine after medical school.
column3: 我表哥想在醫學院畢業後專攻兒童醫學。
column5: special 特別 + ize：專門做特別的一門

column2: Workers spiked the wooden boards to the ground so they would not move.
column3: 工人用大釘子把木板釘在地上，免得它們移動。
column4: spike a board (用大釘釘牢木板)
column5: spike 是尖釘，當動詞就是用尖釘釘住

column2: After the long run, the boy sprawled on the grass to rest.
column3: 長跑後，男孩四肢攤開躺在草地上休息。
column4: sprawl on the grass (四肢攤開躺在草地)
column5: spr 展開 + awl：像一灘水四散攤開

column2: The doctor gave her medicine to stabilize her blood pressure.
column3: 醫生給她藥物，讓她的血壓穩定下來。
column5: stable 穩定 + ize 使：讓搖晃的東西穩住

column2: The cat stalked a sparrow slowly across the quiet yard.
column3: 貓悄悄地在安靜的院子裡跟蹤一隻麻雀。
column5: stalk 像 walk 加 st：靜悄悄地走過去

column2: Nervous before the speech, he stammered and forgot his first line.
column3: 演講前他很緊張，結結巴巴地忘了第一句。
column5: stammer 諧音「濕塌麼」，嘴巴一直卡住說不順

column2: Grandma starches her cotton shirts so the collars stay stiff.
column3: 奶奶替她的棉襯衫上澱粉漿，讓領子保持挺直。
column5: starch 是澱粉，當動詞是把衣服漿硬

column2: Thick vines strangled the young tree and blocked the sunlight.
column3: 濃密的藤蔓勒住小樹並擋住陽光。
column5: strang 像 string 繩子：用繩子緊緊勒住

column2: Poor soil can stunt the growth of young plants in a garden.
column3: 貧瘠的土壤會妨礙花園中幼苗的生長。
column5: stunt 像 stump 矮樹樁：長不高

column2: Smoke filled the room and nearly suffocated the people inside.
column3: 煙霧瀰漫整個房間，差點讓裡面的人窒息。
column5: suf 在下面 + foc 喉嚨：在下面壓住喉嚨

column2: He supplemented his small salary by teaching piano on weekends.
column3: 他週末教鋼琴來補貼微薄的薪水。
column5: sup 在下 + ple 填滿：在下面補滿缺口

column2: Her final score surpassed the school record by five points.
column3: 她的最終成績比學校紀錄高出五分。
column5: sur 超過 + pass 通過：從旁邊超越過去

column2: The two friends swapped lunch boxes and tried each other's food.
column3: 兩個朋友交換便當盒，嚐了對方的食物。
column5: swap 諧音「死襪」，兩人互換襪子

column2: The white dove symbolizes peace in many cultures around the world.
column3: 白鴿在世界許多文化中象徵和平。
column5: symbol 符號 + ize：用符號代表

column2: The artist textured the walls with a rough brush to look like stone.
column3: 藝術家用粗刷在牆上做出紋理，使它看起來像石頭。
column4: texture a wall (使牆面有紋理)
column5: texture 是質感，當動詞是做出質感

column2: Small businesses thrive when local people support them every week.
column3: 當在地居民每週支持時，小型商家便會興旺。
column4: thrive in a place (在某處繁盛)
column5: thrive 諧音「三夫」，三夫一起打拚就繁榮

column2: After running up the stairs, her heart throbbed loudly in her chest.
column3: 她跑上樓梯後，心臟在胸口怦怦地跳動。
column5: throb 的聲音像「撲撲」，是心臟跳動的聲音

column2: The church bell tolled twelve times at noon across the quiet town.
column3: 教堂的鐘聲在中午響了十二下，傳遍安靜的小鎮。
column5: toll 名詞是過路費，鐘動詞是慢慢敲響

column2: Protesters toppled the old statue in the middle of the square.
column3: 抗議者推倒了廣場中央的舊雕像。
column5: top 頂端 + ple：從頂端翻倒下來

column2: Mosquitoes can transmit diseases from one person to another.
column3: 蚊子會把疾病從一個人傳染給另一個人。
column5: trans 跨越 + mit 送：送到另一邊

column2: Farmers transplanted the rice seedlings from small trays into the wet field.
column3: 農夫把秧苗從小盤移植到濕潤的田裡。
column5: trans 轉移 + plant 種：換個地方種

column2: Please do not tread on the wet floor after it has been mopped.
column3: 地板拖過後請不要踩在濕地板上。
column5: tread 諧音「踹得」，一腳踹得下去就是踩

column2: The group trekked for six days through the mountains to reach the lake.
column3: 這群人在山中跋涉六天才抵達湖邊。
column5: trek 諧音「追客」，追著客人走了好遠的路

column2: Signs warn visitors not to trespass on the private farm.
column3: 告示牌警告遊客不要擅自闖入私人農場。
column4: trespass on land (擅自進入土地)
column5: tres 越過 + pass 通過：跨越界線進去

column2: Dust and smoke can trigger an asthma attack in some children.
column3: 灰塵與煙霧可能誘發某些孩子的氣喘發作。
column5: trigger 是扳機，一扣就引發動作

column2: Reporters uncovered a secret plan to close the old hospital.
column3: 記者揭露了一項關閉舊醫院的秘密計畫。
column5: un 去除 + cover 蓋子：把蓋子掀開

column2: Her grandfather will undergo surgery on his knee next Monday morning.
column3: 她的爺爺下週一早上要接受膝蓋手術。
column5: under 在下 + go 走：走到刀下，也就是接受

column2: Our class will undertake a project to clean the beach every month.
column3: 我們班將著手進行一項每個月清理海灘的計畫。
column5: under 在下 + take 拿：把重任擔在肩上

column2: She tried to undo the knot and set the little bird free.
column3: 她很快解開繩結，讓小鳥自由。
column5: un 反向 + do 做：把做好的再反向拆開

column2: As the story unfolded, the audience grew more curious about the stranger.
column3: 隨著故事展開，觀眾對那位陌生人越來越好奇。
column5: un 打開 + fold 摺：把摺起的東西打開

column2: The judge promised to uphold the law no matter who broke it.
column3: 法官承諾無論誰違法都會維護法律。
column5: up 向上 + hold 握：高高舉住不讓它倒

column2: A friendly guide ushered the guests into the bright concert hall.
column3: 一位親切的接待員引領賓客進入明亮的音樂廳。
column4: usher guests in (引領賓客入內)
column5: usher 諧音「阿許」，請阿許帶你入座

column2: Smart cooks utilize every part of the vegetable instead of wasting it.
column3: 聰明的廚師會利用蔬菜的每個部分，而不浪費。
column5: util 有用：use 的正式說法，把有用的拿來用

column2: Street sellers vend roasted sweet potatoes beside the station every winter.
column3: 每年冬天，街邊小販在車站旁販賣烤地瓜。
column5: vend 在 vending machine 販賣機裡

column2: The old company is verging on bankruptcy after three bad years.
column3: 經過三年不景氣，這家老公司瀕臨破產。
column5: verge 是邊緣，站在懸崖邊就是瀕臨

column2: The scam victimized dozens of elderly people who lost their savings.
column3: 這場詐騙害了數十位年長者，他們損失了積蓄。
column5: victim 受害者 + ize 使：使成為受害者

column2: Close your eyes and visualize the beach, the sand, and the waves.
column3: 閉上眼睛，想像海灘、沙子和浪花的樣子。
column5: vis 看 + ual + ize：在腦中看見畫面

column2: The little girl felt sick on the bus and vomited into a bag.
column3: 小女孩在公車上不舒服，吐進了袋子裡。
column5: vomit 諧音「我米」，吃的米都吐出來

column2: This old temple can withstand earthquakes and typhoons, as it has for three hundred years.
column3: 這座古廟經得起地震和颱風，三百年來一直如此。
column5: with 對著 + stand 站：面對風雨依然站得住
